title: Request: SV Battlers for People3_5, People3_7, and People3_8 (VX Ace RTP)

posts.author: riquecamargo
posts.body:
Request: SV Battlers for People3_5, People3_7, and People3_8 (VX Ace RTP Characters)
Resource Type:
Sideview Actor
Maker Format:
MZ
Makers I Own:
VX, Ace, MV, MZ
Art Style:
MZ RTP style (something that matches the official SV battlers Actor)
Description:
Hello everyone! I am looking for SV Battlers (sideview battle characters) that are compatible with RPG Maker MZ and based on three characters from the People3 file in the VX Ace RTP.
They are located in the following positions in the People3 file:
5th character
(first on the bottom row, left side),
7th character
(third on the bottom row),
8th character
(fourth on the bottom row, far right).
I am attaching images showing exactly which characters I am referring to.
Spoiler:
images faces
Spoiler:
IMAGE CHARSET
I have searched a lot on Google and forums, but unfortunately, I have not found any SV Battlers for these characters.
I would kindly ask if anyone could create these battlers or, if anyone has seen something similar, if they could help by sharing the link or the resource they found.
I would be very grateful, and if anyone is able to fulfill the request, I will give full credit in my project. Also, I would like this resource to be shared with the community, so others can benefit from it too.
Thank you very much in advance for your attention and any help!
